scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: Recomputed Markov |G_M|<=C_U/M and the exact tail with K(0). The L1 tail exponent 1-1/r is positive for r>1; this does not claim an Lp tail when p>r. A finite delta-net of Q approximates every convex combination by a compact finite-dimensional simplex. Measurable first-nearest cells give nonnegative average weights and put interval averages in the closed hull. Choosing M before the finite net transfers total boundedness to untruncated interval integrals. Simon then uses the separately assumed target Lp translation norm. This is a local compact-hull reconstruction of the source mechanism, not a claim that Maitre printed it.
